DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • Pillar of Frost is active, regardless of talents, or the Death Knight doesn’t talent into Pillar of Frost.
  • The Death Knight uses Obliteration or has Breath of Sindragosa active (during its buff window if talented).
  • If no Breath/Obliteration talents are selected, prioritize Power Infusion alignment with Pillar of Frost when possible.
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • They have active pets in a burst window and meet specific timing thresholds: Gargoyle will expire within 22 seconds, or Army of the Dead/Abomination minions will expire within 18 seconds
  • Multiple targets (3+ enemies) are present and either Dark Transformation is active or Death and Decay is affecting the area
  • Dark Transformation is active and they haven’t taken Summon Gargoyle or Army of the Dead talents
  • Gargoyle isn’t active and its next possible summon would occur 10 seconds after Power Infusion expires, ensuring no overlap
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • They are actively transformed by Metamorphosis, their primary offensive cooldown, to amplify burst damage.
  • The encounter will end within 20 seconds, ensuring the buff is fully utilized before combat concludes.
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • They activate Celestial Alignment or Incarnation: Chosen of Elune, as these are their primary damage cooldowns.
  • They cast Convoke the Spirits during their burst window to maximize its rapid spell casts.
  • They are channeling Astral Communion during Orbital Strike (if talented) to amplify their stacked haste effects.
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • Bloodlust/Heroism is active, or if the Druid is not using the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent.
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • They have Dragonrage active and (Shattering Star is unavailable, its debuff is already applied to the target, or there are 2+ active enemies)
  • The fight will end in under 35 seconds, regardless of other cooldowns
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • The hunter's Trueshot has over 12 seconds remaining on its duration (typically within the first 8 seconds of activation).
  • The fight will end in under 13 seconds, ensuring full utilization before combat ends.
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • They have Coordinated Assault active.
  • They do NOT have Coordinated Assault talented AND Spearhead is on cooldown.
  • They do NOT have Spearhead AND do NOT have Coordinated Assault talented.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • They do not have Spymaster's Web equipped and just cast Arcane Surge.
  • They have Spymaster's Web equipped and just finished casting Evocation.
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • Power Infusion isn’t active AND one of the following is true:
    • their Combustion is about to come off cooldown (within pre-cast preparation time)
    • they have over 7 seconds remaining on their active Combustion buff
    • the encounter will end in under 20 seconds
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • they do not already have the Power Infusion buff active.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • Xuen the White Tiger is active.
  • Either Bloodlust is not active or while Bloodlust is active, Strike of the Windlord is still on cooldown.
PALADIN_RETRIBUTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Retribution Paladin when:

  • Their Avenging Wrath is active
  • Their Crusade buff is active (if using that talent)
  • The target has the Execution Sentence debuff applied
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • They are in Voidform or have activated Dark Ascension to amplify their burst damage window
  • They benefit from the The War Within 2/4-piece tier set bonus enhancing their rotational output
  • Power Infusion isn’t already active on them
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • The target has the Deathmark bleed effect active to amplify burst damage during their highest cooldown windows.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • They activate Shadow Dance, aligning with their burst window to amplify damage-dealing abilities.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • They are actively channeling Ascendance to amplify their burst window.
  • Ascendance has more than 30 seconds remaining on its cooldown, ensuring you don’t delay Power Infusion’s usage unnecessarily.
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds are active to amplify their burst damage window.
  • The encounter is in its final 20 seconds to maximize uptime before the fight ends.
  • All of their major cooldowns (Ascendance, Feral Spirit, Doom Winds) have over two minutes remaining before being available again.
  • They have not specialized into Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds in their talent build (use on cooldown).
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • Their major damage cooldowns are active, specifically during Darkglare summoning windows aligned with Rapid Corruption or Summon: Soulkeeper bursts
  • They have already activated Soul Rot and seed of corruption preparation is complete
  • Their combat resources (soul shards) are primed for Malefic Rapture or Unstable Affliction spam sequences
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • Their Demonic Tyrant summon aligns with a large group of imps about to expire (variable.imp_despawn), and those imps will despawn within the next 2 global cooldowns + Tyrant cast time.
  • They’ve just cast Hand of Gul’dan or Ruination to prepare for their burst window.
  • Either:
    • Imps are expiring within 1 global cooldown + Tyrant cast time, or
    • They have fewer than 2 Soul Shards, signaling an imminent Tyrant cast.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • Their Summon Infernal is currently active (to amplify this major damage window)
  • They did not select the Summon Infernal talent (for alternative burst setups)
  • The encounter will end before their next Summon Infernal becomes available with at least 15 seconds remaining on the timer (to avoid wasting the cooldown)
  • The fight lasts less than Summon Infernal's remaining cooldown + 10 seconds, but more than Power Infusion's duration (to capitalize on final burst opportunities)
WARRIOR_ARMS:
Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:

  • Their target has the Colossus Smash debuff and the fight will last at least 135 more seconds.
  • They’re in the Execute phase (sub-20% target health) and Avatar is active.
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds, regardless of other conditions.
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • Avatar has over 15 seconds remaining and the encounter will last at least 135 more seconds.
  • They enter the Execute phase (target below 20% health) while Avatar is active.
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds.
